title: Ἐπιτομὴ τῶν Ταρραίου καὶ Διδύμου παροιμιῶν / Zenobius' Epitome of Proverbs (vulgate, CPG I) / «Собрание пословиц» Зенобия
author: Zenobius, sophist (epitomizing Didymus and Lucillus of Tarrha)
genre: Paroemiography: proverbs with explanations and aitia
size: 552 proverbs in six 'centuries' (CPG I pp. 1–175). Estimate about 25k words. The Athos recension adds material.
edition: Leutsch & Schneidewin, Corpus Paroemiographorum Graecorum I (Göttingen 1839; PD, archive.org). W. Bühler, Zenobii Athoi proverbia (1982–99; partial, in copyright).
ru_evidence: No ru.wikipedia article on Zenobius and no translation listed. Searches find only isolated proverbs quoted in other articles (e.g. 'Спорить о тени осла').
en_evidence: No English translation found (en.wikipedia 'Zenobius', OpenAlex). Proverbs are treated only piecemeal in commentaries.
other_translations: Italian complete: E. Lelli, I proverbi greci. Le raccolte di Zenobio e Diogeniano (2006); also Lelli (ed.), Proverbi, sentenze e massime (Bompiani 2021). Portuguese partial (Revista Hypnos, 2025).
value: Proverbs explained through myth, local history, lost comedy and Didymus' scholarship. Rich in folklore, religion and ethnography; source of Erasmus' Adagia. Readable for a broad public and ideal to show off commentary. Could be extended to Diogenianus and Ps.-Plutarch.
ai_feasibility: high: short self-contained prose entries. Commentary must trace sources (Didymus, comic fragments) and parallels in Diogenianus and the Suda. Lelli's Italian can serve for cross-checking.
